system.name: PRISM
system.one_liner: Decodes fMRI into structured object-level text with a fine-tuned language model, then uses that text to guide a diffusion model that reconstructs the seen image.

content.variant_note: three dashed-separated bands (description generation with attribute search, training, inference); hatched wedges open two training boxes into a detail row
content.argues: Structured, object-centric text descriptions are the supervision that lets an fMRI encoder plus language model predict text that guides object-centric image reconstruction.
content.subject: PRISM's three phases: VLM description generation with attribute search, fMRI-to-text training, and object-centric inference.

Bottom: 'Inference' strip left to right ending in a tinted generation region and the output photo.

evidence: Framework Overview: PRISM generates structured text descriptions for each training image using a VLM
fMRI signals are more similar to the text space of a language model
the predicted structured descriptions guide an adapted diffusion model to generate object-centric images directly from fMRI signals

summary: PRISM reconstructs the image a person saw from their fMRI scan by using a language model's text space as the latent space. The figure stacks three bands. The top band shows a pre-trained VLM, steered by an iteratively searched attribute and relationship set (scored by CKA and LPIPS), writing a structured description for each training photo. The middle band trains an encoder and fine-tunes a language model to predict those descriptions from fMRI; hatched wedges open the training boxes into a detail row where predicted object cards are tied to the reference cards by red 'LM loss' arrows. The bottom band runs inference: fMRI to text, per-object conditions, cross-attention, concatenation and the reconstructed photo. One elephant-on-road example runs through all bands.
summary_zh: PRISM 从 fMRI 重建被试所见图像：先让 VLM 按搜索出的属性与关系给训练图写结构化描述，再训练编码器并微调语言模型把脑信号映射到文本，推理时用预测描述引导扩散模型。图分三层，斜线楔形放大训练框，一只大象贯穿始终。
notes: Prior pre-screen kinds kept (stage-pipeline, model-anatomy). The three bands are counted as one drawing (panel_count 1) because the zoom wedges and the red dashed link cross the dashed rules. The red versus green word colouring in the description cards is not explained in the figure or in the paragraph provided; it is read as marking differing spans. Head and brain images are inferred to be bitmaps from the digest's placed-picture count.
